title: Canceling a view command clears its typed entry
detail: At 2d6d4637, typing into a view entry with a confirm command, pressing Enter, and selecting Cancel clears the text. The submit path removes the text before opening the dialog (native/crates/attn-app/src/view/draw.rs:794), and cancellation discards the pending run (view/commands.rs:202–216). The user must retype even though the command was canceled. Preserve the entry draft across cancellation and verify the entry and confirmation paths together with a benign input. Two readers confirmed the code trace. No fresh live reproduction was completed.
